grammar.summary: 本课学习表失控的语义群与 as fast as possible。

points.title: as...as possible 尽可能
points.explanation: He drove as fast as possible = 尽可能快地开。as + 副词原级 + as possible 高频结构。

examples.en: The boat was out of control.

points.title: 表冲击的 dash/glide 动词精准度
points.explanation: The boat dashed against the rocks. dash（猛撞）/glide（滑行）——动词的画面感选择。

examples.en: The boat glided across the lake at tremendous speed.
examples.cn: 船以极快的速度掠过湖面。
